text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we passed 
in front of a crepe shop.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Crepes, huh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah~? I don't care, like, at all?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Crepes are fluffy, gooey, and look all 
cute and stuff... total wimp food, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit too sweet for a tough guy like 
me...

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Serving up our super popular treat! We've 
got the 'Rich Cream Double Honey 
Choco-Banana Crepe' right here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly! Let's eat some meat, 
meat! If it ain't a hearty meal, it 
doesn't even feel like eating~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's a kebab stand in the park on 
our way back! Let's stop by there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Never mind crepes!

She's clearly tempted by the crepe... But 
breaking down the stubborn act she's 
putting on feels a bit childish, so...
choice_data_list: I want to eat this, will you join me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh...! You're getting crepes!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"P-Pathetic for grown adults, ain't it? 
Being in a fancy-schmancy place like this, 
I mean."
choice_data_list: I just have to eat it right now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
......Hmmmm. Sheesh, guess it can't be 
helped~

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually eat this stuff, but if 
you're asking that nicely, I guess I'll 
keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, miss! Could we get a look at 
the menu, please?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"She wouldn't stop whining that she 
aaaabsolutely HAD to eat it... Heheh ♪"
And so, we each bought our favorite crêpe—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, so sweeeet! Way too sweet, dammit♪

We enjoyed the delicious crepes and were 
thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... R-Right!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! When you're an Umamusume, 
nothin' beats a good kebab!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainerrr! The meat is waiting 
for us!

And so, arriving at the park with the 
kebab stand—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Two of your most standard 
kebabs, please!
choice_data_list: And add Turkish ice cream to that as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're eating ice cream too? That's 
quite a lot, you know.
choice_data_list:
Eating a big hearty portion is cool too, 
right?

Eating a big hearty portion is cool too, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...! I get it now...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it works, then there's no 
way in hell I can pass this up...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Two Turkish ice creams, please!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this is such a super deluxe set! 
Time to dig in~♪

Being able to eat both meat and sweets 
left Vodka thoroughly satisfied.
